facts.value: The International Office for Economics is the central point of contact for all department students with questions related to international topics. In particular, it advises students on organizing a study abroad and supports guests from foreign partner universities during their studies in Frankfurt.

Here, international students receive an easier start at Goethe University and in Frankfurt through a Frankfurt buddy. Experienced students from the university provide support for orientation on campus, in studies, and in Frankfurt. The goal is to facilitate the start for international students in Frankfurt (student) life and to give all participants the opportunity to meet interesting new people from various countries.
The Gender Equality Council of the Department of Economics offers an English course for administrative staff (m/f/d) during the lecture period. Please send an email for interest in participation.
